title: Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights
abstract: arXiv:2610.12527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. translated_title: 从净智能电表实现表后光伏发电可见性：部署模式与运营洞察
translated_abstract: 配电网运营商需要对表后光伏（PV）发电的可见性，然而大多数住宅用户仅通过净智能电表进行观测。基于深度学习的光伏分解技术可以恢复这种可见性，但其运营价值取决于模型是服务于已知用户、新用户、未来时期还是新区域。我们利用四种部署模式来量化这种依赖关系，这些模式将家庭间迁移与时间外推区分开来，应用于Ausgrid智能电表数据，并进行跨数据集适应到Pecan Street数据。采用固定的训练协议，我们在与部署模式匹配的评估下，对代表性的深度序列架构进行光伏分解基准测试。在固定的48小时上下文长度下，最佳模型的日间平均绝对误差（MAE）从已见家庭在未来测试期的0.104千瓦上升到同期未见家庭的0.185千瓦，并且在固定训练条件下……
tldr: 本文提出四种部署模式来系统评估基于深度学习的净智能电表光伏分解方法，揭示了模型在已知用户、新用户、未来时期和新区域等不同场景下的性能差异，为电力运营商提供了实际部署的关键运营洞察。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes four deployment regimes to systematically evaluate deep-learning-based PV disaggregation from net smart meters, revealing performance differences across known customers, new customers, future periods, and new regions, and providing key operational insights for distribution utilities.
